_comment: Backup of the SageReasoning Gate-1 hooks block for .claude/settings.local.json. This is the canonical 'ON' state used by the /sage-on and /sage-off skills. Contains NO credential (the SAGE_GATE1_CREDENTIAL lives in the settings 'env' block, not here). /sage-off refreshes this file with whatever hooks are currently installed before removing them; /sage-on merges this 'hooks' object back in. Hooks: H1 UserPromptSubmit (top-level framing), H2 PreToolUse Task|Agent (subagent framing), H3 PreToolUse Bash|Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit (at-action: guard + consult + loop-closure), H4 Stop (reflect turn + accred + persistReflection).
